fixtures.construction: Four-second 440 Hz sine at 10^(-12/20) full scale with 960-frame (20 ms) raised-cosine fade-in and fade-out.
Four-second 880 Hz sine at 10^(-12/20) full scale with 960-frame (20 ms) raised-cosine fade-in and fade-out.
Frame-interleaved stereo: the canonical 440 Hz mono tone on the left and canonical 880 Hz mono tone on the right.

Sixteen attacks at exact 12000-frame (250 ms) intervals. Each 2400-frame attack is 0.45 * exp(-70*t) times the mean of cosine partials at 180, 360, 720, 1440, 2880, and 5760 Hz; all carriers remain below Nyquist.
4096-frame mono input: 0.2*sin(2*pi*440*t) + 0.1*sin(2*pi*660*t), multiplied by 128-frame raised-cosine edge fades.
